evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01", a date with no time. A POST with no dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2026-09-02"} returned 200 with the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. A later PATCH of only the title left dueDate null.
evidence.AC3: I sent "2026-02-30", "14.10.2026", "abc", 123 and "2026-13-01" as dueDate, once with POST and once with PATCH. All 10 requests returned HTTP 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14. I created todos due 2026-10-01 (not done), 2026-12-01, 2026-10-14 (today), no due date, and 2026-09-01 (later marked done). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 2026-10-01 todo. ?overdue=false returned the other four. The done todo with a past date showed overdue false.
evidence.AC5: The list page showed "fällig 01.10.2026", "fällig 14.10.2026" and "fällig 01.09.2026" next to the matching todos. Todos without a due date showed no date.
evidence.AC6: On the page, only the todo 'past' (due 01.10.2026, not done) had the text "überfällig". The today, none, future2 and pastdone todos had no such marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo.
